_note: Curated prerequisite / equivalence / placement discrepancy register. Each entry separates what an OFFICIAL source says from what SYLLO interprets. No entry here changes planner behaviour; 'proposed_resolution' is a recommendation awaiting the owner where approval_required is true. Re-verify with scripts/prerequisite_discrepancy_register.py.

entries.title: ME mandatory Numerical Analysis requires an Electrical-Engineering Python course the official ME plan never schedules

official_evidence.statement: 0542-1821 וגם 0509-1645 וגם 0509-1820 (all three joined by 'וגם' = AND)
0542-3804 is mandatory at Y2/B; 0509-1820 (תכנות - פייתון) is not part of the Mechanical Engineering official plan

entries.conflict: Verified AND-requirement vs the official default ME plan: a student who follows the official plan cannot satisfy 0509-1820. Parsing is correct (the registrar page literally lists AND), so this is an official-source inconsistency, not a parser error. Likely registrar data lag (0542-1821 is the ME programming course) but that is an interpretation.
entries.proposed_resolution: Keep as ADVISORY (do not block). Ask the Mechanical Engineering department / registrar whether 0509-1820 is still required or replaced by 0542-1821. Do not create an equivalence without a source.
entries.planning_impact: High: a mandatory Y2/B course; strict enforcement would invalidate every official ME plan.

entries.title: Spec places Y4 mandatory courses in 'either' semester while official notes/timetable fix semester 7 or 8

official_evidence.statement: 0542-4010 taught in semester 7 only (Y4/A); timetable agrees
0542-4020 taught in semester 8 only (Y4/B); timetable agrees

entries.conflict: spec.mandatory_courses uses semester 'either' for both. With 'either' the evaluator can place 0542-4020 in the same semester as 0542-4010 (blocked) or before it.
entries.proposed_resolution: Record the official semester windows (4010/4092 → A, 4020 → B; 0542-4092's note is cited in spec.source_conflicts) in course_rules as official constraints; already listed in spec.source_conflicts as 'Not applied'. Needs approval because it edits an official requirement record.
entries.planning_impact: Medium: removes the only intra-Y4 sequencing false positive on the default ME path.

entries.title: Fluid Mechanics (1) window 'semester 4 or 5' vs verified prerequisite Thermodynamics (1) fixed at Y2/B

official_evidence.statement: 0542-2500 listed under Y2/B and Y3/A: 'יש לקחת את הקורס בסמסטר 4 או 5'
0542-2600 listed under Y2/A and Y2/B: 'יש לקחת את הקורס בסמסטר 3 או 4'

entries.conflict: The spec fixes 0542-2600 at Y2/B (semester 4) and 0542-2500 at Y3/A (semester 5). Official windows allow 2600 in semester 3, making 2500 in semester 4 feasible. With the spec's fixed placement, 2500 can only be semester 5 and its dependants 0542-3620/3792 cannot be Y3/A even though the spec lists them 'either' (Y3).
entries.proposed_resolution: Represent the official windows (2600: sem 3|4; 2500: sem 4|5) as window rules and let the planner choose the semester subject to the verified prerequisites; early_year_courses.json (2500 at Y2/B) and mandatory_2027.json (Y3/A) are each valid only under one choice of 2600. Needs approval.
entries.confidence: official (windows) + verified prerequisites; the resulting feasible set is derived by SYLLO
entries.planning_impact: Medium: with fixed placements the default path is valid only if 3620/3792 sit in Y3/B; today they may be proposed in Y3/A and are flagged.

entries.title: Retired prerequisite 0542-1830 (Intro to Materials Science) — inferred equivalence to 0581-1111

official_evidence.statement: No catalog record for 0542-1830 in 2021, 2022, 2023, 2025 or 2026 (probed)
0581-1111 מבוא למדע והנדסה של חומרים exists, semester B, in 2024, 2025 and 2026
0542-2400, 0542-3780, 0542-4091 require 0542-1830 as an AND member; no registrar page lists 0581-1111 as an alternative

entries.conflict: The registrar still names a number it no longer lists. The mapping to 0581-1111 is SYLLO/owner inference (approved 2026-11-14), not a university statement.
entries.proposed_resolution: Leave status 'inferred', Mechanical-Engineering scope only. Ask the department to confirm; upgrade only on a source. Any use stays labelled inferred and is advisory-only.
entries.planning_impact: High: gates three mandatory/core ME courses; an unmapped retired id would block all of them.

entries.title: Equivalence 0509-1510 = 0542-1510 is recorded as INFERRED although the official program page states the courses are identical

official_evidence.statement: 0509-1510 listed through 2025/26, absent in 2026/27; 0542-1510 listed 2026/27 only (probed 2026-11-18)

entries.conflict: data/prerequisites/equivalences.json says 'The university does not state the equivalence' while spec course_rules equiv-0542-1510-0509-1510 quotes an official statement. Our two records contradict each other.
entries.proposed_resolution: Add a distinct status 'program_page_stated' (official, scoped to the program page that states it) and migrate this entry to it. NOT applied automatically: the owner decides whether the program-page statement suffices.
entries.planning_impact: Medium: removes an 'inferred' label from 3 courses' prerequisite chains.

entries.title: Physiological Systems (2) is required by 0555-3240 but not in any probed catalog
entries.conflict: No successor can be identified from an official source. 0555-2106 has a similar name but no official link.
entries.proposed_resolution: Remain unresolved (satisfies nothing, blocks nothing); keep advisory and show the student the unresolved requirement. Candidate lead for the department: 0555-2106.
entries.planning_impact: Low: a single elective outside the main ME/EE paths.

entries.title: Image Processing (0512-4262) is the only prerequisite of Video Processing (0512-4263) but is not offered in 2026/27
entries.conflict: The requirement names a course that may be rotating rather than retired; no replacement identified.
entries.proposed_resolution: Remain unresolved/advisory; availability of 0512-4262 in future years should be checked each catalog refresh.

entries.title: Retired ids that appear only inside OR groups

official_evidence.statement: Each id is listed as one alternative ('או') beside a current course; see computed section for the sibling alternatives.

entries.conflict: None blocking: an unmatched alternative cannot invalidate an OR whose sibling is satisfiable. They appear in the 'not in catalog' counts but need no mapping.
entries.proposed_resolution: No equivalence needed. Exclude from 'blocking unresolved' metrics; keep recorded.
entries.confidence: verified (derived from the official expression structure)
entries.planning_impact: None, provided the sibling alternative is plannable.
